prompts: Describe the room you would build in a memory palace to hide one thing from yourself.
A tarot card is missing from every deck in the world. Which one, and what changed when it vanished?
Write a letter to the version of you that exists in the mirror.
You are the scribe of a minor god nobody worships any more. Record today's miracle.
Invent a sigil for something you want. Describe its shape, then what happens the night you draw it.
The hermit in the ninth card finally speaks. What does the lamp illuminate?
Write the instructions found taped inside a secondhand grimoire.
A sacred chicken refuses to eat. Write the consul's diary entry that evening.
Describe a ritual for saying goodbye to a habit.
Your shadow files a complaint. Write it.
A city where every street is named after a dream someone had there. Walk one street.
Write the inscription on the underside of the world.
The alchemist's apprentice turns lead into something that is not gold. What?
Translate the song a moth hums to a lamp.
A deck of cards that predicts only small things. Read today's spread.
Write the minutes of a meeting of the four elements.
You inherit a key with a label that says 'do not'. Do not what?
Describe the smell of a place you have only visited in sleep.
An oracle can only answer in recipes. Ask it about love.
Write the last page of a diary kept by a lighthouse.
The Fool steps off the cliff. Describe the fall from the dog's point of view.
A library where each book is a person's unspoken thought. Borrow one.
Write a prayer to the patron saint of lost umbrellas.
Something lives in the static between radio stations. It wants a name.
Map the twelve houses of your own small zodiac: your kitchen, your street, your phone.
Write a spell that only works if you forget it.
The haruspex finds a key inside the liver. Where does it lead?
Describe your life as an illuminated manuscript. What is in the margins?
A message arrives written in birds. Decode it.
Write the dialogue between a stone and the river that is shaping it.
What would your familiar be, and what does it disapprove of?
Write a tarot card for the modern world: The Algorithm, The Commute, The Group Chat…
Describe a door that opens only on the solstice.
A ghost who has forgotten what it was haunting. Help it remember.
The seventh son of a seventh son is a dentist. Write his strangest appointment.
Write the warning label for enlightenment.
A forest where the trees are slowly writing a novel in their rings. Read a chapter.
Describe the colour of a sound you heard as a child.
Write an invocation for a quiet Tuesday.
Your name, spelled backwards, is the name of a demon. What is its job?
An astronomer discovers a star that only appears when no one is looking. Write their notes.
Write the rules of a game played by the dead.
The moon writes you a postcard.
Describe an object that is bigger on the inside, in the most mundane setting possible.
A coven meets in a laundromat. Write the agenda.
Write about a time a coincidence felt like a message.
Describe the cartographer who mapped the underworld and what they got wrong.
Write a horoscope for a houseplant.
Something in your house is older than the house. What?
Write the confession of a crystal ball.
An I Ching hexagram that doesn't exist: draw it in words and name it.
Describe the ceremony for crowning the king of a kingdom of three people.
Write a lullaby for a monster.
You are a word that has fallen out of use. Plead your case.
A labyrinth with a gift shop at the centre. What do they sell?
Write the epitaph for an idea you've given up on.
Describe the dream of the person sitting next to you on a train.
Write instructions for building a raft out of regrets.
The sacred geometry of an ordinary sandwich.
Write what the stars would say if they could see us.
blankTitles: A page for nothing in particular
